equivalentQuery: SELECT TOP (3) OrderId, CreatedAtUtc, Total FROM dbo.Orders WHERE (CreatedAtUtc = '2026-07-02T09:00:00' AND OrderId > 3) OR CreatedAtUtc > '2026-07-02T09:00:00' ORDER BY CreatedAtUtc ASC, OrderId ASC;
